title: DOP-C02: the loop behind most correct answers

steps.title: Detect
steps.note: Config rule, CloudWatch alarm, GuardDuty finding, or a metric filter on application logs

steps.title: Route
steps.note: Config remediation, EventBridge rule, composite alarm, or the CodeDeploy deployment group

steps.title: Act
steps.note: Automation runbook, automatic rollback, Lambda or Step Functions, or a lifecycle hook

steps.title: Record
steps.note: A record is left behind, for example an OpsItem in Systems Manager OpsCenter
